step: Bootcamp: Reproduce the Ala-Ala verdict (Ala-Ala vs Gly-Gly in 98% sulfuric acid)
source: Petkowski et al. 2024, Sci. Rep. 14, 17083 (calls); Petkowski et al., ACS Omega 2025 (the Ala-Ala product)

AA_signals.label: Ala-Ala C-H signals
AA_signals.why: two methyls and two alpha-H, one of each per residue

AA.call_source: the published finding (Petkowski et al. 2024, Sci. Rep. 14, 17083)
AA.close_message: Free alanine is what water would give. In 98% acid the mechanism study reports alaninamide: one alanine keeps the amide end. See Look closer for its reference spectrum.
AA.product_source: the mechanism study (Petkowski et al., ACS Omega 2025, Mechanism for peptide bond solvolysis in 98% w/w concentrated sulfuric acid; reference spectra on Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.11122291)
